annotations.title: Get a shareable AI visibility report

description: A link to the brand's AI visibility report to share with a team or client: how often AI answers mention the brand, which competitors they name instead, and which sources they cite. Returns the newest finished report's own unlisted link. Reports are built automatically after a brand's first scan.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands or add_brand. May be omitted when the workspace tracks a single brand.
